PART I

PART I.
NOMINATION; DETERMINATION OF CANDIDATES

§12-1 Application of chapter. All
candidates for elective office, except as provided in section 14-21, shall be
nominated in accordance with this chapter and not otherwise. [L 1970, c 26, pt
of §2]
